sources.title: Dar al-Ifta: How to perform Prayer (Salah)
sources.supports: Daily schedule, intention, movement sequence, threefold bowing/prostration phrases, between-prostration wording, two-rakah ending and extension to three/four units. A Sunni teaching outline, not identical legal classifications in every school.

sources.title: Dar al-Ifta 8030: New Muslim unable to recite Fatiha
sources.supports: Temporary dhikr and shorter seated recitation for genuine inability while learning; not a reason to abandon learning Arabic or delay prayer.

sources.title: Darul Ifta Birmingham: Reciting behind the imam
sources.supports: Hanafi position: the follower does not recite Quran behind the imam. This does not mean omitting all other prayer phrases.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 757
sources.supports: Unhurried bowing, upright standing, prostration and sitting; no claim rushing always has one universal remedy.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 831
sources.supports: Complete tashahhud includes peace on righteous servants and both testimonies of faith, omitted in the old article.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 3370
sources.supports: Arabic blessings name Muhammad and his family, Ibrahim and his family, in both halves, with hamidun majid in each. One narrated wording; independently phrased English meaning.

sources.title: Sahih Muslim 772
sources.supports: Bowing and prostration praises and rising phrases match the Arabic. Threefold repetition is attributed separately to Dar al-Ifta, not this narration.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 776
sources.supports: Al-Fatiha and another surah in the first two, Al-Fatiha alone in the last two of Dhuhr; broader teaching sequence supported by institutional guide.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 1117
sources.supports: Standing adapted to sitting, then lying on side when unable; no specific chair/prostration prescription inferred.

sources.title: Quran 5:6: Purification before prayer
sources.supports: Purification includes ablution and full purification for janabah; no universal one-minute washing claim.

review.notes: Read institutional sources and Arabic/English hadith passages. Corrected incomplete tashahhud and missing salawat, scoped instructions to Sunni prayer alone, distinguished Hanafi congregational recitation. Removed blanket phone-reading permission, fixed memorization deadlines, oversimplified madhhab chart and universal mistake remedy. Three headings, no repeated FAQs. Original title/date/author/tags/image path preserved; placeholder art replaced under user authorization. AI-assisted editorial source checking, not independent scholarly review.
